arStrings.szText:
{if:Mod.Side1}{c_label}Generates Energy:{/c} {c_resource}{SF_7}{/c}
{/if}{c_label}Cooldown:{/c} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c} seconds
Vanish from sight, gaining an advanced form of {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:CONCEALMENT}{/c} seconds that will not be removed by taking damage. 

{c_important}Concealment{/c} also makes you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c}, grants {c_number}[{SF_3} * 100|%+|]{/c} Movement Speed, and {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} for its duration.

Using an attack Skill during {c_important}Concealment{/c} will break {c_important}Concealment{/c}.
Greatly increased Movement Speed and Dodge chance.
Breaking Concealment grants {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|+%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance.
Heals {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life over {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} seconds.

Casting {c_important}Concealment{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_26}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}. After breaking {c_important}Concealment{/c}, you gain {c_number}[SF_28 * 100|1%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance for the next {c_number}{buffduration:GUARANTEED_CRIT}{/c} seconds.

Entering {c_important}Concealment{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life over {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} seconds. Breaking {c_important}Concealment{/c} Knocks Down Close enemies for {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} seconds.

When you break {c_important}Concealment{/c}, all Nearby enemies are covered in a shadowy mist for {c_number}[SF_15]{/c} seconds, causing them to become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and explode for {c_number}{payload:SHADOW_AOE}{/c} Shadow damage when it expires.
{c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} persists for {c_number}{buffduration:SIDE3_UNSTOPPABLE}{/c} seconds after breaking {c_important}Concealment{/c} when Cast.
Gain {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} after breaking {c_important}Concealment{/c} when Cast.
